title: OMIR MemoryRecord (R1)
description: The atomic unit of agent memory: a remembered experience, plan, prompt, or learning. OMM level 4.

content.description: WHAT — the primary human-readable content of the memory.

kind.description: Record lifecycle class. One core record, several lifecycles; retrieval stays unified.

experienceType.description: Finer-grained nature of the experience. 'intention' denotes prospective (future-directed) memory.

tier.description: Position in the memory hierarchy. Promotion is driven by age x importance x access.

eventTime.description: WHEN the described event actually happened. MAY precede createdAt (encoding time).

entityRefs.description: References to Entity resources mentioned by this memory. Enables spreading activation without a graph lookup.

parentId.description: Parent MemoryRecord id, for hierarchical knowledge trees.

validUntil.description: Temporal invalidation: this record is considered superseded after this instant.

informationContent.description: EP-1: information content (novelty/surprisal) against a generative prior — the 'store the surprising, regenerate the predictable' watt lever. OMM-0; producer-relative (see Theory & Scope).

replayPriority.description: EP-4: producer-relative consolidation/replay priority (surprise x value x recency snapshot) prioritizing amortized OFFLINE re-embedding/consolidation. Snapshot as of meta.lastUpdated; producer-relative. OMM-0.

interference.description: EP-4: rational-eviction / interference signal (need-probability, local density, competing traces). Closes divergence D10. OMM-0.
